in_marathi.name: Nirmay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirmay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nirmay refers to the creator or maker in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir' meaning 'without' and 'may' meaning 'form'. This name is given to a child believed to have the potential to create or bring about positive changes.
